title: statusline r3 UX: confirmation prompt does not disclose its settings write
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 3. Lens: ux (validator: documentation-reviewer). Owner: SO session. Defect: init's first interactive confirmation authorizes writing adopter-owned settings.json but the spec contracts only 'on operator confirmation' — not that the prompt names its write target, default, and decline path; a confirmation that hides its side effect is the interactive-prompt failure mode. Citations verified: contract:159, :216, :184. Proposed: deferred-candidate, foldable one-sentence spec fix (prompt copy itself lands at 1c).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree (deferred folded; prompt copy itself still lands at 1c authoring). Spec-level disclosure contracted: the confirmation prompt names the settings file it will write, states the default, and names the decline path. Revision: Install bullet.
